discoveries.observation: duo-build hard-wires a cross-vendor peer; only Claude available, so the peer ran same-vendor via duo reviewer invocation
discoveries.proposedEdit: Install codex in agent environments or accept and record same-vendor peers
discoveries.publicSummary: Duo peer ran same-vendor; independence recorded in the ledger

discoveries.observation: Improvement vs preservation depends on the check sample; baseline expectation per criterion is too coarse
discoveries.publicSummary: Baseline expectations need to be per check set

discoveries.observation: Peer redirected a false complete, then stopped with an infeasibility proof and a user-owned decision
discoveries.proposedEdit: Keep Duo rounds as the improve build loop; surface user-owned steps as the human decision
discoveries.publicSummary: Duo rounds caught a false claim and routed a real scope decision to the human

discoveries.observation: Holdout at 1280px caught footer harm the 1440px practice sample missed
discoveries.proposedEdit: Keep evaluator-authored holdout with different widths/data as the deciding set
discoveries.publicSummary: The held-out sample caught harm the practice sample missed

discoveries.observation: Fixed card max-height plus fixed control set makes readable names and no body harm incompatible on narrow cards
discoveries.proposedEdit: Human chooses: card may grow, or Settings/Flip move into the card menu on narrow cards, or stop
discoveries.publicSummary: HeyStax card header needs a human scope decision before another run
